errors.text_span: Approximate bar heights by family are: IE-Baltic shows small positive values (mBERT-L₂ ~2, XLM-L₂ ~1–2, mBERT-R₂ ~3, XLM-R₂ ~3, mBERT-B₂ ~6, XLM-B₂ ~5); IE-Germanic shows mid values for L₂ and B₂ with R₂ near/below zero (mBERT-L₂ ~10, XLM-L₂ ~10, mBERT-R₂ ~0 to −1, XLM-R₂ ~−1 to −2, mBERT-B₂ ~15, XLM-B₂ ~15); IE-Indic shows near-zero L₂, larger R₂, and the largest B₂ bars (mBERT-L₂ ~1, XLM-L₂ ~0, mBERT-R₂ ~20, XLM-R₂ ~18, mBERT-B₂ ~24, XLM-B₂ ~21); IE-Romance shows moderate L₂ and R₂ with higher mBERT-B₂ (mBERT-L₂ ~6, XLM-L₂ ~4, mBERT-R₂ ~5, XLM-R₂ ~1, mBERT-B₂ ~12–13, XLM-B₂ ~5–6); IE-Slavic shows L₂ around ~9–11, small R₂ near ~0–1, and B₂ around ~15–17 (mBERT-L₂ ~10–11, XLM-L₂ ~9, mBERT-R₂ ~1, XLM-R₂ ~0–1, mBERT-B₂ ~17, XLM-B₂ ~15–16); IE-other shows L₂ around ~5–6, R₂ near zero, and B₂ around ~8 (mBERT-L₂ ~6, XLM-L₂ ~6, mBERT-R₂ ~0–1, XLM-R₂ ~0, mBERT-B₂ ~8, XLM-B₂ ~8); Isolate shows values clustered near zero to ~2 (mBERT-L₂ ~0, XLM-L₂ ~0, mBERT-R₂ ~1–2, XLM-R₂ ~1, mBERT-B₂ ~2, XLM-B₂ ~1–2); Semitic shows L₂ and B₂ in the low-to-high teens with negative R₂ bars (mBERT-L₂ ~11, XLM-L₂ ~16, mBERT-R₂ ~−2, XLM-R₂ ~−3, mBERT-B₂ ~15, XLM-B₂ ~19–20); and Uralic shows all bars close to zero with a small positive mBERT-B₂ (most series ~0–1, mBERT-B₂ ~2).
errors.evidence: The description provides excessive numerical detail that does not add significant informational value beyond the reference description.
